data.one_liner: A simple DI library using Dart Zones for scoped dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides a way to register and resolve values within a zone‑based scope. Overrides can be applied per‑scope and are automatically respected in async code. No code generation or Flutter‑specific widgets are required.
use_when: You need lightweight, runtime‑only dependency injection in pure Dart or Flutter projects.
You want scoped overrides that work across async boundaries without extra boilerplate.
avoid_when: You require compile‑time safety or code‑generated bindings.
You need integration with Flutter widget trees or provider‑style APIs.
strengths: Zero code‑generation, works out of the box.
Scoped overrides are easy to test and work with async code.
weaknesses: Relies on Zones, which can be confusing for newcomers.
No compile‑time checks for missing bindings.
Smaller ecosystem compared to more popular DI packages.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, widely used DI container with global singleton support and extensive community examples.

alternatives.name: injector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar runtime registration with a simpler API and broader adoption.
